notes.title: August 29. It's very soon
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey friends![/b]
It's been a while since I last posted anything here on Steam. Honestly, I’m a bit nervous getting back into it 😅[/p][p]A little over a year and a half ago, I released the first season of [i]My Future-Ex Family[/i].
I never expected it to get so many sales and so much attention on Steam.
Right after release, I started working on the second season. But then… it turned out not to be a season at all — just a DLC.[/p][p]Once the DLC was out, my friends and I dove straight into developing Season Two.
And damn — it turned out so much better!
Yeah, we kinda [i]overdid it[/i] with the episode length, and there's less branching than before, but we’re going to fix that in the upcoming expansion.
On the bright side: each episode got longer, there are way more renders, and the animations feel more alive than ever.[/p][p]And guess what — the game now has sound!
Not just basic door clicks, but full sound design for animations and scenes.
It’s not full voice acting (yet), but we’ve added over [b]3,000[/b] sound effects![/p][p]New fan-favorite characters have joined the cast — beautiful and sexy as ever.
Some of the less popular girls were written out of the story. And, by the way, we’ll be doing the same cleanup after Season Two.[/p][p]I’d love to write more — so much has happened in the past 20 months — but hey, I’m more of a dev than a writer 😉
If you have any questions, feel free to drop them in the comments — I’ll do my best to reply![/p][p]And most importantly…
we’ve finally locked in our release date:[/p][p][b]August 29th[/b] [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692280/My_ExFuture_Family_Season_2/" style="button"]Add My Ex-Future Family Season 2 to your wishlist![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43141006/4ad9c54d683756e3908165ffbef5694c3cb758c3.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: When choices matter. New co-op bundle from KerGames!
notes.notes:
Hi friends!

We’re excited to announce something special:
A new Steam bundle featuring My Ex-Future Family: Season 1 and the critically praised With Eyes Closed is now available!

🎮 https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54499/Choice_matters/


Why this bundle? Because both games share something important:
Your decisions shape the story. Every choice you make leads to new outcomes, different scenes, and unique relationships.



✨ Whether you’re navigating a house full of secrets in My Ex-Future Family or diving into the psychological depths of With Eyes Closed, one thing is certain — your path is yours to control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/e323cdcb92c9fb3c12efd5ba1636ac0b345c8203.gif[/img]

[i][u]With Eyes Closed[/u] - Season 1[/i] is a thriller in the adult visual novel genre. It concentrates on storytelling, realistic characters, and letting players control the development of the story. The game also features plenty of hot scenes that are interwoven into the storyline. 

[b]STORY[/b]

You came to consciousness in the trunk of a car. You don't remember who you are and how you got there. Your hands are cuffed, and two dead bodies are lying around. But very soon you will learn that this is not the biggest of your problems. 
Will you make it out alive? Will you find out who kidnapped you and why? Will you learn whom you can really trust and who is just using you for their own purposes? 
The answers to these questions depend only on you. 

[b]KEY FEATURES[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/HD54k459/2.gif[/img]
[u]Branching storyline.[/u] Your decisions determine how the story is told.

[u]Ultra quality visuals.[/u] The game is available in 2k QHD resolution (optional).
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zhsBsJ8H/5.gif[/img]
[u]Extremely smooth animations.[/u] All animations are done in 60 fps and are also available in 2k QHD (optional).
[u]Next gen character models.[/u] All main characters use Genesis 9 model, which was released in late 2022. Genesis 9 brings double the mesh density and 8K HD materials. This means more detailed mouth textures and shapes, higher quality eyes, eyelashes, and eyebrows, less stylized/more natural postures and so much more!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/FqJkfj2W/3.gif[/img]
[b]MAIN CHARACTERS[/b]

 [b]Kate[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/RpG5bnKZ/kate.jpg[/img]
A redheaded beauty, trustworthy, and always ready to help. You could hardly wish for a better friend, especially one with such curves.
 
[b]Eva[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/DHqQb4bB/eva.jpg[/img]
Blonde doctor with big blue eyes. Can you find out what lies behind the mask of a self-sufficient and icy woman?
 
 [b]Luna[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/S7DcXsqK/luna.jpg[/img]
A young lady in distress, and you're the only one who can come to her aid. But how will she reward you?

 [i]And many other girls are waiting for you![/i]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/35Xb2MNd/girls.jpg[/img]

And now you can experience both journeys together at a great price.

🛒 Check out the bundle here and let us know what you think!
Don’t miss your chance to explore two unforgettable worlds where choice really does matter.

— TremmiGames & KerGames Teams

notes.title: Developer Diaries: Episode 6
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

It’s been a while since we last shared some news, though work hasn’t stopped for a moment. The holidays, reworking old content, adding new material, implementing sound effects, and visual polish—all of it takes time.

Today, I want to tell you about our work on the sixth episode of the game. A large amount of code and dialogue has become the norm for us, and honestly, that’s something we’re proud of. Sure, sometimes it’s challenging to visualize all of our ideas, but isn’t it better to aim for more rather than less?

Some of the animations turned out so great that it fills us with pride in what we’re creating. As I mentioned last time, we have set deadlines for each episode, and I’m 90% confident that we’ll finish the second season by August of this year. In fact, we have five episodes left to complete, polish the visual elements, add more sound effects and animations, and then wait for your reaction to the final product. That’s the big picture.

Now, let’s focus on what awaits you in the sixth episode.

First, a bit of stats:

[list]
[*] 30+ sexual animations :-)
[*] 4 new hot! scenes
[*] Almost 500 new artworks (474, to be exact) ːsteamhappyː
[*] 40 minutes of gameplay—though if you play carefully, it’ll be even longer
[*] Achievements, special hidden pictures, and kitties
[*] Development of storylines, not just the main ones, but side plots as well
[/list]

As always, I’ll continue to delight you with new artwork from the sixth episode :)

Let's play basketball!
